title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to add a Signature Pad to the Sales Order page (Capture and Save Customer Signatures)
summary: Adding a signature pad to the Sales Order page in Business Central using control add-in objects allows customers to sign digitally and save signatures directly within the system. The post demonstrates a real-world implementation using public JavaScript libraries from CDN.
key_points: Control add-in objects integrate external JavaScript libraries like signature_pad from CDN or cdnjs into Business Central
Customer Delivery Signature group enables users to write by hand, clear mistakes, and save signatures
Customer Signature Preview Factbox stores and displays saved signatures with delete functionality
Feature works across Web Client, Tablet, and Phone clients without additional customization

quotes.text: Unlike the calculator we looked at before, we can find this directly in public JS libraries, such as in CDN or cdnjs
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows how to leverage existing open-source JavaScript libraries for control add-in development without building from scratch

quotes.text: This is not limited to the Web Client; it can also be used on the Tablet and Phone clients.
quotes.why_it_matters: Indicates cross-client compatibility extends the feature's usability across multiple platforms
